units.source_text: [\[12\]](#part1334.html#w12) 日本女人坐时双膝下跪，坐在脚跟上。

en.t: [12] When Japanese women sit, they kneel with both knees on the floor and sit on their heels.

units.source_text: 所以膝行甚便，与中国人的膝行意义不同。

en.t: Therefore moving forward on the knees is very convenient for them, and it has a different meaning from kneeling movement among Chinese people.
